purpose: Replace anonymous repeated /wc launches against mutable global frontier with one Guide-compiled immutable run packet whose workers atomically self-assign unique launch slots, load long exact context only after slot ownership, and remain resident after completing the slot's first project.

human_contract.note: The Guide emits one prompt containing one run_id. Slot numbers are machine-assigned atomically; the human never types or tracks S01/S02/etc.

packet_projection.rationale: Pages is the compiled read surface. Put enough exact context, acceptance criteria, candidate bundles, source refs, non-goals and test commands there to minimize worker archaeology.

slot_model.selection_seed: fresh beacon commit SHA when available; otherwise launch_nonce
slot_model.selection_rule: Filter packet slots by capabilities definitively available in the runtime; hash into the compatible slot list; on CREATE_EXISTS advance cyclically through untried compatible slots. No mutable frontier reread is required to obtain a slot.

slot_capsule.authority_boundary: The packet/capsule supplies context and routing intent; durable PIN/claim remains execution authority unless the slot itself is an explicitly authorized synthetic benchmark fixture.

capability_aware_occupancy.rule: Guide computes launch slots from compatible demand, not total candidate count. Generic chat runtimes do not consume slots whose required capabilities are definitively unavailable.
capability_aware_occupancy.oversubscription_allowed_when: Measured slot completion/replenishment evidence justifies it; never infer from raw frontier_total alone.

observability.benefit: A human statement such as 'I launched 17 chats' becomes directly comparable to a durable run packet instead of being inferred from timestamps.

residency.after_primary_complete: Return evidence, refresh exact allowed allocation surface, claim a second compatible project/lane, and continue until residency target or real boundary.
residency.existing_pool_law: 3 checkpoint / target 6 / cap 8 remains binding unless benchmark-specific stricter completion is declared.

implementation_order: Build canonical PACKET compiler from Current Mission + compatible frontier + capability buckets
Build public /launch/<run_id>/ projection containing packet + per-slot capsules
Add atomic launch-slot claim protocol to /wc before ordinary job allocation
Add run/slot fields to beacon, runtime and scoreboard
Add packet accounting tests so slots_claimed can never exceed slots_total and one slot has at most one owner
Only then arm the graduation benchmark
non_goals: replacing execution authority with a static webpage
creating filler slots to hit a desired worker count
making packet creation an endless experiment
